summary: Scores every candidate action against the battle state and picks the best. New behaviour is a list entry.
overview: Makes an actor AI-controlled. On its turn the manager asks for an action, and this scores each candidate against the current battle state and returns the highest. A new enemy behaviour is a new candidate entry in the Inspector rather than new code.
useCases: A healer that prioritises hurt allies.
An aggressive enemy that focuses whoever is weakest.
Varying enemy personality by reordering and reweighting candidates.

params.tuning: Each pairs an action with how it scores. Tuning the weights is how an enemy's personality is expressed.

gotchas.title: Ties are broken by order, not randomly
gotchas.body: Two equally scored candidates always resolve the same way, so an enemy can look robotically predictable. Add a small random term if that matters.
